empty.detail.cache: They are deleted right away, without the Trash. Apps make them again when needed, so the first use may be a little slower.
empty.detail.packages: They are deleted right away, without the Trash. Projects used in the last 7 days are kept. A deleted project needs pnpm install (or npm install) before it runs again.
empty.detail.build: They are deleted right away, without the Trash. Folders used in the last 7 days are kept. A deleted project's next build starts from scratch and takes longer.
